name: Magga
summary: Magga is an orc resident living in the dusty settlement of Razor Hill within Durotar. Stationed near the town's lively tavern, she serves as a welcoming face for newly arrived Horde adventurers making their way out of the Valley of Trials.

sections.title: A Welcoming Face in Razor Hill
sections.body: Razor Hill serves as the first real taste of the wider world for young orcs and darkspear trolls emerging from the Valley of Trials. Positioned right beside the local inn, Magga greets new arrivals to the outpost. While she keeps a low profile among the outpost's busy grunts and tradespeople, she helps bind the small settlement together.

faq.answer: Magga is an orc civilian stationed in Razor Hill, Durotar. She stands near the inn, welcoming new Horde travelers and pointing them toward lodging and rest.

faq.q: What is Magga's connection to Innkeeper Grosk?
faq.answer: No special tie between them is recorded. Magga keeps near the Razor Hill inn, where Innkeeper Grosk offers travelers food, drink and a place to bind their hearthstones.
Magga receives the 'Welcome!' errand: adventurers who carry a Razor Hill Gift Voucher hand it to her, and she welcomes them to Azeroth with a small companion as a gift.

angles.text: For fresh recruits leaving the harsh trials of the Valley of Trials behind, Magga provides a reassuring welcome to Durotar's first true settlement.
